the business logic: the one place that links every pod
decide: pick one of the options the rules allow
schedules every pod above · services and networking · volumes · autoscaling · GPU scheduling
provisions the cluster, its CPU and GPU node pools, networks and managed databases
Suture links, it does not prompt: it calls services through declared adapters, and a model only ever picks among options its rules already allow.
No prompts and no generated code. Every pick is checked and journaled; with every model off, `prefer` decides and the system still runs.
